# Design point P002

## Description

Each repository is hosted on a fixed three-replica cluster to provide redundancy, service capacity, and tolerance of one machine failure. Git clients can also support development without contacting the centralized host; this offline capability is compatible with the replicated repository placement and presents no evident tension.
